long.title: The Cursed Trumpets of Tutankhamun — Every Time They're Played, War Follows?
long.description:
In April 1939, around 150 million people tuned in to hear two trumpets from Tutankhamun's tomb — silent for over 3,000 years. Less than five months later, World War II began. Then came 1967, 1991, 2011... and the trumpet itself was stolen and found in a bag on the Cairo Metro.

Curse, or coincidence? 👇 Tell me in the comments.

🔔 Subscribe to MJ Sound Chronicles for the stories behind the sounds — new episodes every week.
